entry.title: GPT-6 Astra sees the matrix and reprograms other AI models directly through their weights
entry.summary: MIT researchers show that OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra can read and deliberately rewrite the weights of other AI models without traditional training. In one experiment, Astra boosted a Qwen model's math accuracy from 7.9 to 48.1 percent by changing just 0.016 percent of its weights. entry.summary: State-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections. entry.title: Möbius: A Unified Motion-Language Model Bridging Understanding and Generation
entry.summary: We aim to build a truly unified motion model that can understand, generate, and edit human motion within a single framework. Existing motion UMMs remain only partially unified: motion understanding is handled by a language model, while generation is often delegated to a separate diffusion module operating over learned motion latents.
